comment: The equaliser is applied after the amp model, not before it (src/dsp/Nam.h:215-223). The noise gate and equaliser settings are read once per 128-sample block rather than every sample (src/NamPlayer.cpp:127), so a fast CV into any of those nine jacks is quantized to that block. Model loading happens on a background thread, so the module keeps passing audio while a large model loads.
